justification: The ghost captures the qualitative skeleton—five states, a contraction-rate mechanism, grade-climbing for degenerate cases—but strips all the precision: no spectral radius, no rho notation, no delta-ratio bootstrap, no period-based limit-cycle distinction, no budget_exhausted flag, no generative-over-contraction pathology. These are not stylistic paraphrases; they are load-bearing technical claims that the original locks down and the ghost leaves open or absent. The loss is structured (coherent in what remains) and recurses (a finer pass could recover the missing formal apparatus), making this a partial reconstruction, not noise.
